title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. Activities and the objective include conducting protection risk assessments, develop appropriate feedback and complaints handling mechanisms and, participatory and information sharing strategies to share expected behaviour staff and the FCHM. So, communities and people affected by crisis can hold Trócaire and local partners accountable against our commitments for an inclusive, dignified, and safe response. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat, Association of Pastoralist community for change and Daughter of Charity-Tigray.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 4.1The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this objective is:- Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys
